response:
Reflection: gen 6 produced two clear upgrades to the reigning mix mechanism, and they are structurally independent. Netting recorded intangibles out of the organic-leg denominator (asset-light scaling) gave the best t-alpha and Sharpe of the entire archive (6.6%, t 4.81, Sharpe 0.616) by making the two intangible legs non-overlapping in construction; and replacing the single cash gate with MIN(cash level, accrual quality) gave the highest alpha (6.8%, t 4.76) by repairing the accrual gate's weak slope. Equity scaling also strengthened the short pole (−5.1%, t −4.15, Sharpe −0.539), and the two-pole composite now holds the best Sharpe (0.633). Failures to respect: coverage-buying substitutions (FFO fallback), trajectory gates, budget-coverage gates, and acquisition-flow penalties all cost alpha, so I will not revisit them. With two generations left after this, this batch is deliberately consolidation-weighted: combine the two validated gen-6 upgrades, apply the validated scaling insight to both legs at once, rebuild the best-Sharpe composite on the upgraded poles, and spend two slots on the last untested gate concepts (a cash-productivity floor, and liquidity as a second weakest link).

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: Asset-Light Mix On Cash And Accruals
EXPRESSION: MUL(RANK(SUB(RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), SUB(at, COALESCE(intan, 0)))), RANK(RATIO(COALESCE(intan, 0), at)))), MIN(RANK(MA(RATIO(oancf, at), 3)), RANK(NEG(RATIO(SUB(ib, oancf), at)))))
HYPOTHESIS: Hidden knowledge capital per tangible dollar, net of purchased intangibles, is credible precisely when cash generation is high and earnings are cash-backed; the weaker of those two conditions binds.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This unites the two independent gen-6 improvements — the asset-light organic denominator (best t-alpha 4.81 and Sharpe 0.616) and the MIN(cash, accrual) conjunctive gate (best alpha 6.8%) — which act on different parts of the expression and were each validated against the same baseline. Because neither change touched the other's component, the effects should be close to additive rather than redundant, making this the leading candidate for the final signal. Coverage is unchanged at roughly 9%, so any improvement is not a sparsity artifact.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: Hidden Capital Versus Equity At Risk
EXPRESSION: MUL(RANK(SUB(RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), SUB(at, COALESCE(intan, 0)))), RANK(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), COALESCE(intan, 0)), ceq)))), MIN(RANK(MA(RATIO(oancf, at), 3)), RANK(NEG(RATIO(SUB(ib, oancf), at)))))
HYPOTHESIS: Each intangible leg should be scaled by the base that makes it economically meaningful: unrecorded knowledge capital against tangible assets it leverages, and purchased intangibles against the book equity a write-down would destroy.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Equity scaling of acquired intangibles improved the standalone short pole from −5.6%/t −4.02 (asset-scaled) to a Sharpe of −0.539 with t −4.15 and a stronger slope, and asset-light scaling improved the long pole, but no signal has yet applied both scalings inside a single differenced leg. This tests whether the mix premium widens when each pole is measured against its own economically correct base, holding the best gate fixed. It is a single, well-motivated design change relative to Signal 1.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: Intangible Mix On A Cash Floor
EXPRESSION: MUL(RANK(SUB(RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), SUB(at, COALESCE(intan, 0)))), RANK(RATIO(COALESCE(intan, 0), at)))), RANK(TS_MIN(RATIO(oancf, at), 5)))
HYPOTHESIS: Durability is best evidenced by the worst year: a firm whose cash productivity never fell below a high level across five years can fund intangible investment through any environment.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The earnings-based floor (TS_MIN of ROA) preserved t-alpha but collapsed the Sharpe to 0.169, which I attribute to accounting write-offs and one-off charges contaminating the minimum of `ib`; the same construct built on operating cash flow should be far cleaner because cash flow is immune to non-cash charges. This is the one gate concept — a one-sided cash durability floor — that the archive has never tested, and it distinguishes "never weak" from "high on average" (MA) and "not volatile" (VOL). If it beats the MA gate, the mechanism is about downside resilience rather than average strength.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: Triple Weakest-Link Credibility Gate
EXPRESSION: MUL(RANK(SUB(RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), SUB(at, COALESCE(intan, 0)))), RANK(RATIO(COALESCE(intan, 0), at)))), MIN(MIN(RANK(MA(RATIO(oancf, at), 3)), RANK(NEG(RATIO(SUB(ib, oancf), at)))), RANK(NEG(VOL(RATIO(oancf, at), 5)))))
HYPOTHESIS: Full credibility requires cash flow that is large, cash-backed in the accounting sense, and stable; a firm failing any one of the three should not be treated as a durable intangible producer.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: All three conditions have been individually validated as gates (alpha 5.3%, 5.7%, 5.9% respectively), and MIN is the only combination operator in this archive that stacks conditions without dilution — unlike SUMRANK averaging (3.0%) or nested multiplication (4.7%). The risk is that a triple minimum makes the gate too restrictive and destabilizes the extreme portfolios, which the Sharpe and t-alpha will reveal directly. Testing it now settles how far the conjunctive logic extends before the final generation.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: Upgraded Two-Pole Credibility Composite
EXPRESSION: SUB(RANK(MUL(RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), SUB(at, COALESCE(intan, 0)))), MIN(RANK(MA(RATIO(oancf, at), 3)), RANK(NEG(RATIO(SUB(ib, oancf), at)))))), RANK(MUL(RANK(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(gdwl, 0), COALESCE(intan, 0)), ceq)), RANK(NEG(MA(RATIO(oancf, at), 3))))))
HYPOTHESIS: The long pole (asset-light hidden capital at cash-rich, low-accrual firms) and the short pole (purchased intangibles overhanging thin equity at cash-poor firms) are distinct mechanisms, and each performs best with its own gate rather than a shared one.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The separately-gated composite already holds the archive's best Sharpe (0.633) using older leg definitions, and this version rebuilds both poles with the gen-6 winners: asset-light scaling plus the MIN gate on the long side, equity-scaled impairment exposure on the short side. Because a differenced-leg design (Signal 1) forces one common conditioner while this design allows two, the pair jointly identifies whether the gate should be shared or pole-specific. Rank differencing keeps the composite bounded and stable.
INTERACTION_TYPE: novel

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: Intangible Mix With Liquidity Constraint
EXPRESSION: MUL(RANK(SUB(RANK(RATIO(TS_SUM(COALESCE(xrd, 0), 5), SUB(at, COALESCE(intan, 0)))), RANK(RATIO(COALESCE(intan, 0), at)))), MIN(RANK(MA(RATIO(oancf, at), 3)), RANK(RATIO(act, lct))))
HYPOTHESIS: Working-capital liquidity is the balance-sheet dimension of credibility: a firm whose current assets comfortably cover current liabilities will not raid its innovation budget to meet near-term obligations, even in a bad quarter.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The economic story names balance-sheet quality explicitly, but every attempt to capture it has used leverage or debt-service stocks, which produced strong t-alphas with near-zero FMB slopes because they are non-monotone; the current ratio is a smoother, more monotone measure of near-term financial slack. Pairing it with the proven cash gate inside MIN gives the balance-sheet channel its fairest test within the structure that is known to work. If it succeeds, the credibility condition is broader than cash generation alone.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional
